description: Ranged Shadow attrition - health-cost casts bank Rage and Thirst, Thirst goes into Vampiric Fang for a lifesteal burst, and the same spells that kill the target keep you standing.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_bloodmage__sanguine.txt: 'Closest to Affliction Warlock crossed with a Blood DK personal-survival layer. Like Affliction you pay your own health to cast, stack ramping debuffs ... and grind a target down over time rather than bursting it.' The tree follows its stat priority - Spell Hit > Spell Power > Haste > Crit > Spirit/Stamina > Intellect - which is why Cunning of Atherann converts Stamina and Spirit rather than Intellect, and why Intellect appears nowhere: 'no mana pool is spent'.

nodes.name: Atherann's Wickedness
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow damage by 2% and your hit rating by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Shadow damage dealt by 4% and increases your hit chance by 3%.' <school>_spell_damage is assembled at runtime from the school an ability actually deals, which is why a literal grep calls it dead.

nodes.name: Darkfallen's Embrace
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell haste by 3% and increases the range of your Sanguine spells and Bloodbolt by 5 yds.' There is no range stat in a turn-based engine.

nodes.name: Blood Banquet
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Valanar's Vengeance and Keleseth's Calamity by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Valanar's Vengeance and Taldaram's Torment by 15%.' Pointed at the two Rage nukes the rotation actually dumps into, since Taldaram's Torment already has its own node.

nodes.name: Cunning of Atherann
nodes.description: Grants spell power equal to 3% of your Stamina and 3% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell damage by 25% of your Stamina and Spirit.' A real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion, resolved against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py. This node is why Sanguine's stat priority wants Spirit and Stamina on a caster.

nodes.name: The Cup Runneth Over
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Bloodbolt and Bloodmoon Blast by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Bloodmoon Blast, Taldaram's Torment and Bloodbolt by 20%.' Spell power coefficients are not per-ability here, so it is flat damage on the two fillers.

nodes.name: Twisted Magic
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 20% chance per rank to leave the target taking 2% more magic damage from you.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your direct harmful critical strikes increase the target's Shadow damage taken from you by 2%, stacking up to 5 times.' _sync_talent_procs scales a multi-rank proc's CHANCE by points spent, not its payload, so the ranks buy reliability rather than size. shadow_damage_taken_pct is live at runtime but is assembled from an f-string, so audit_talents cannot see it and reports it dead - magic_damage_taken_pct is the same mechanic through a key the tooling can verify.

nodes.name: Bloodwell Eruption
nodes.description: Increases the damage your area attacks deal to additional targets by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the radius of Sanguine Rupture by 5 yds and its critical strike chance by 10%.' Radius is not a thing here; the node keeps the identity by paying off the pack hit itself.

nodes.name: Blood Parasites
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Taldaram's Torment now generates 3 additional Rage per tick and increases spell critical strike chance against the target by 3%.' Per-target crit has no hook. CoA's stat priority names this node as a crit payoff.

nodes.name: Lifedrinker
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Vampiric Fang by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of your Vampiric Fang by 25%.' More damage is also more lifesteal, since damage_and_heal's heal half scales off the same node path.

nodes.name: Enthraller
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Valanar's Vengeance and Keleseth's Calamity by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Valanar's Vengeance and Keleseth's Calamity by 10%.' ability_<id>_crit is percentage points, the same unit as crit_chance_spell.

nodes.name: Hematoma
nodes.description: Your Bloodbolt has a 33% chance per rank to drain a share of the damage it deals back into you.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Bloodbolt now heals for an additional 20% of the damage dealt.' ability_filter is what makes a proc fire off one named ability rather than any damage cast.

nodes.name: Dominion of Blood
nodes.description: Increases the healing you do by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Vampiric Fang now heals you for an additional 50% of the damage dealt.' healing_done is the global multiplier every heal and every damage_and_heal goes through, so it covers the Fang and the rest.

nodes.name: Agonizing Pain
nodes.description: Increases the damage your effects deal over time by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by your Atherann's Anguish now causes enemies hit to bleed.' A DoT spawning a second DoT has no hook, so the node makes the ones already running hurt more.

nodes.name: Reckless Abandon
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike damage by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each stack of Thirst now increases your critical strike chance by 1%.' Thirst stacks are Vitality, which nothing reads as a scaling source, so the crit identity lands on crit damage instead.

nodes.name: Essence Harvester
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 6% less damage and are healed for 3% more, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Being struck by an enemy while below 35% health instantly resets the cooldown of your Vampiric Fang and grants you Wretched.' A conditional cooldown reset has no proc shape, so the node keeps the 35% threshold and pays off surviving there. low_health_threshold_pct is in UNSCALED_EFFECT_KEYS, so it stays 35% at every rank.

nodes.name: The Council Assembled
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of Keleseth's Calamity and the health cost of Atherann's Anguish by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Atherann's Anguish now costs -25 less Rage.' POSITIVE means a reduction for a _cost_pct key - talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct) - and eight shipped talents once authored these negative and quietly made their abilities more expensive.

nodes.name: Swarm of Flies
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your effects that deal damage over time by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Bloodbolt now refreshes the duration of Taldaram's Torment.' Refreshing one named DoT off another ability has no hook; longer DoTs are the same idea with the same payoff.

nodes.name: Dark Presence
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases spell haste of all party and raid members by 3% ... In addition, increases your spell haste by 3%.' A talent's effects only ever modify its owner, so only the self half is here; the party-facing buffs in this class are abilities, where buff_scope works.

nodes.name: Crimson Curse
nodes.description: Increases the damage your bleeds deal by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Your direct damage critical strikes increase the damage the target takes from bleed effects by 30% for 15 seconds.' bleed_dot_damage is assembled as f'{flavour}_dot_damage' in Ability._damage_multiplier.

nodes.name: Torture
nodes.description: Increases the health Vampiric Fang returns to you by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the leech of Vampiric Feast by 50%.' ability_<id>_healing feeds the heal half of a damage_and_heal, and was one of the suffixes that sat dead across six classes before anything read it.

nodes.name: Thirst for Blood
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA ships this as a free level-50 passive, which Frontier has no equivalent of, so it becomes a real node.

nodes.name: Blood Lord
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Grants your Bloodsore a -15% chance to provide its benefits without being consumed.' Bloodsores are a charge mechanic with no hook, so the node pays the spec's main stat instead.

nodes.name: Crimson Terror
nodes.description: Your blood answers to you rather than the other way round. Grants spell power equal to 10% of your Spirit, and increases your Shadow damage by 5%.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Your Transgression now grants spell damage equal to 50% of your Spirit for the duration.' A window tied to one buff is not expressible as a talent, so the conversion is permanent at a fifth of the size.
